signal: Spekit was named a Visionary in the first Gartner Magic Quadrant for Revenue Enablement Platforms and shipped 25+ new features turning buyer signals into revenue, plus new product and marketing leadership.

email.body1:
Freddy, saw Spekit land Visionary in Gartner's first Revenue Enablement MQ and ship 25-plus new features around buyer signals.

Momentum like that usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals quietly stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Spekit off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Freddy, quick follow-up for Spekit.

With Gartner recognition driving inbound, pipeline targets tend to climb faster than headcount can. Most leaders cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Spekit needs to cover this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Freddy, last bit of proof for Spekit.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Spekit's reply rate likely compares to other B2B SaaS companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Freddy, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a Gartner nod and a big release, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a B2B SaaS motion? I will tailor it to Spekit either way.
